stops.note: beg meant "lord, chief"; -um was a feminine suffix of nobility
feminine of the Turkic title 'beg', lord; Mughal royal women held the title
used as a title for women of high rank under the Mughal Empire
entered English through British contact with Mughal and later South Asian courts
stops.meaning: title for a Muslim woman of rank

current_meaning: a Muslim woman of high rank, or a title of respect for a married Muslim woman, especially in South Asia
